Jamal: hey team - Jamal here, joining as AE next Monday. Quick items: HubSpot + Gong, Dialpad softphone, demo laptop image, and where to grab the one-pager deck and playbook? who do i loop in for custom slides?
Onboarding Bot: welcome @Jamal! :tada: Provision ticket created: https://redwood.in/onboard/Jamal. You'll get auto-add to #sales-onboarding. Complete the form to speed approvals.
Casey (sales-ops): hey @Jamal, i'll handle HubSpot & Gong. Fill provisioning and include your preferred email alias and timezone. HubSpot seat usually same-day. For Dialpad softphone, choose softphone or forwarded number and preferred caller ID.
Jamal: filled form. alias jamal@redwood.com. softphone please, caller ID "Redwood - Jamal"
Casey (sales-ops): noted, queued. Expect Gong invite and Dialpad provisioning update in this thread.
Marta (IT): hi @Jamal - for demo laptop, do you prefer mac or linux image? we have a mac-intel/m1 image and ubuntu-22. Once chosen I'll kick off the build. Post-build run VPN: `curl -fsS https://dl.redwood/vpn.sh | sudo bash`.
Jamal: mac-m1 please.
Marta (IT): ok build started, ETA ~3 hrs.
Renee (AE-buddy): welcome @Jamal! i'll share the AE playbook, first-week shadow calendar, and a 3-call sample pack. Happy to have you shadow Wed 2pm.
Kyle (marketing): @Jamal i'll drop the latest 1-pager and a slide kit. If you need a company-specific slide for demos, DM me the logo and target vertical and i'll assemble.
Jamal: huge thanks everyone. One more: where do we store recorded demo templates (Loom) and consent language?
Casey (sales-ops): consent + recording policy are in the onboarding checklist and the demo training module. Loom access comes from the Tools team; i'll cc them if needed.
Jamal: got it, appreciate it :rocket:
